bundle-contract.rationale: bundle_contract reads SKILL.md metadata and requires these six regular files. Content hashes conservatively include the bytes of presence-only inputs. It does not execute or interpret documented examples.
assumptions: Only the pinned trusted checker executes; candidate configuration is data.
Python, stdlib and PyYAML files are hashed. No concurrent mutation of inputs or installed software during a run.
No external input or network is used. Environment is explicitly set.

upstream-tests.rationale: Reviewed upstream 1f68e035: the 24 tests import sarif_helpers (stdlib only), read both fixtures, and extract LEVEL_FN and CI_GATE plus inspect jq fences in both Markdown files. Generated temporary SARIF fixtures are functions of test code. This scope includes documented commands and the transitive jq program; it does not evaluate prose paths as runtime resources.
assumptions: Run only the named test module, no conftest, plugin autoload, bytecode writes or pytest result cache. Existing compilation caches are hashed, not counted as test-result reuse. New Python/native modules in resources make this reviewed scope unavailable.
Interpreter, stdlib, pytest and its dependency files, jq and linked libraries are hashed. No concurrent mutation during a run.
The pinned standard distribution loader and host OS are trusted. No network or unbound runtime inputs are consumed. Generated temporary data are isolated.
